<function name="OnEntityCopyTableFinish" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>
Called after duplicator finishes saving the entity, allowing you to modify the save data.

This is called after <page>ENTITY:PostEntityCopy</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="data" type="table">The save <page>Structures/EntityCopyData</page> that you can modify.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prevent this entity from being copied and subsequently pasted.</description>
	<code>
function ENT:OnEntityCopyTableFinish( data )
	for k, v in pairs( data ) do data[ k ] = nil end
end
	</code>

</example>
